questions.q: ___ have I seen such a thing.
questions.why: Після заперечного прислівника на початку (*Never*) — інверсія: допоміжне перед підметом: *Never have I seen such a thing.*

questions.q: Rarely ___ she go out.
questions.why: *Rarely* на початку — інверсія з *does*: *Rarely does she go out.*

questions.q: Hardly ___ I arrived when it started to rain.
questions.why: *Hardly had* + підмет + третя форма + *when*: *Hardly had I arrived when it started to rain.*

questions.q: No sooner had she left ___ he called.
questions.why: *No sooner … than* — сталий парний зв'язок: *No sooner had she left than he called.*

questions.q: Not only ___ he win, but he also broke the record.
questions.why: *Not only did he win, but he also…* — інверсія з *did*.

questions.q: Only then ___ I understand what had happened.
questions.why: *Only then did I understand…* — інверсія в минулому.

questions.q: Which is correct?
questions.why: Допоміжне перед підметом: *Never have I seen it.*

questions.q: So beautiful ___ the view that we stayed.
questions.why: *So beautiful was the view that…* — інверсія після *so* + прикметник.

questions.q: Under no circumstances ___ you open it.
questions.why: *Under no circumstances should you open it.*

questions.q: Never ___ I heard such nonsense.
questions.why: *Never have / had I heard…*

questions.q: Seldom ___ he complain.
questions.why: *Seldom does / did he complain.*

questions.q: Little ___ we know what was going to happen.
questions.why: *Little did we know* — ми й гадки не мали.

questions.q: Not until midnight ___ they arrive.
questions.why: *Not until midnight did they arrive.*

questions.q: ___ had I sat down than the phone rang.
questions.why: Пара *No sooner … than*: *No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.*

questions.q: Only after the exam ___ relax.
questions.why: *Only after the exam did I relax.*

questions.q: At no time ___ the manager informed.
questions.why: *At no time was the manager informed.*

questions.q: Here ___ the bus!
questions.why: *Here comes the bus!* — дієслово перед іменником-підметом.

answer: Never have I seen such a mess
questions.why: *Never have I seen…*
questions.hint: Ніколи я не бачив такого безладу.

questions.why: *Rarely do we eat out.*

answer: Not only did she sing but she also danced
questions.why: *Not only did she sing…*
questions.hint: Вона не тільки співала, а й танцювала.

questions.q: Not until the end of the film ___ who the killer was.
questions.why: Після *Not until …* інверсія стоїть у головній частині: *did we realise*.

questions.q: Only if you practise every day ___ improve.
questions.why: *Only if …* — інверсія в головній частині: *will you improve*.

questions.q: I had hardly closed my eyes ___ the alarm went off.
questions.why: *hardly … when* (або *before*).
